producer_report.summary: I gave OLY-B-S4-01 a mechanism: a pure `check` function in `crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs`. It returns a gap for each explanation that lacks a prompt, code or run source. For the Athena instance it also returns a gap when no source is one of Athena's own records. Blank sources don't count, and a non-Athena instance without records is not flagged. The measure ends `status: not shown`, because no Athena study exists to feed it. Two limits are stated in the module, the spec entry, the changelog and the decision. One record source stands in for "primary" evidence, and a mechanism with no explanation at all is not detected. The new test file passes (16 tests). The xtask suite, the mirrors test, clippy and fmt also pass; I did not run the full workspace test.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-B-S4-01 has a mechanism that is not `none`. It names the new module crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs and the test crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs. The owner is `Athena`. The measure ends with `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`. Check it with Grep on docs/spec.toml.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited the entry; spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism passes and asserts all of this; xtask spec tests pass.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs exists and is registered as `pub mod mechanism_explanation` in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, with a doc line. It exposes a pure function that takes explanation records, each with an instance, a mechanism and typed evidence sources (prompt, code, run, record), and returns a gap for each mechanism missing a prompt, code or run source. For the Athena instance it also returns a gap when no source is one of Athena's own records.
criteria_check.evidence: Module created with check(); lib.rs has the mod line between manage and method_experiment plus a doc bullet; the integration test compiles against it.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`. Tests pass for a complete explanation (no gaps) and fail on planted defects: a missing prompt source, a missing code source, a missing run source, and an Athena explanation with only non-record sources. Each test asserts the specific gap. A non-Athena instance without record evidence is not flagged. The real spec entry test passes: `parse_spec` finds OLY-B-S4-01, the mechanism is not `none`, `measure_problem` returns None, the label check passes, and `spec_gaps` no longer lists it.

A test fails without the mechanism. A spec-check test sets the mechanism back to `none` and asserts `spec_gaps` reports `no_mechanism`. A test asserts that a wrong status label, a measure without the test command, and a wrong owner are each refused. Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`.
criteria_check.evidence: spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism, _a_wrong_status_label, _a_measure_without_the_command and _a_wrong_owner all pass in the 16-test run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, and `cargo test --workspace`. All pass, or the recorded Athena check on the final tree shows them passing (D115). Other tests that read docs/spec.toml, such as crates/athena-gate/tests/bootstrap_requirement.rs, still pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the full workspace test. I ran fmt --check and clippy -D warnings (clean), and cargo test -p xtask and the mirrors test (pass).

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for this change. No existing entry of docs/decisions.md or anything under records/ is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG bullet added first under Added in Unreleased; decisions.md only gained a final D176 section; mirrors test passes (append-only, next-id).
